user.title: Smart Home app push
user.description: Home Assistant sends alerts straight to Apple for the Smart Home app. Use the push key (.p8) from the Apple developer account the app is signed with: Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles › Keys.

data_description.key: Open the .p8 file in a text editor and paste everything, including the BEGIN and END lines.
data_description.sandbox: On for apps installed from Xcode (development signing), off for TestFlight or App Store builds.

error.bad_key: That isn't a push key. Paste the whole .p8 file, including the BEGIN and END lines.

snooze.name: Snooze alerts
snooze.description: Hold back Smart Home app alerts for a while.

key.name: Alerts
key.description: An alert's tag (one camera) or group: "motion" for every camera.
